components.css: .ds-project{position:relative;display:grid;place-items:center;aspect-ratio:16/9;border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden;background:#d4cfc4;color:#111111;font:850 18px 'Inter Tight',Arial,sans-serif;text-decoration:none;transition:transform .55s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),box-shadow .55s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}.ds-project span{transition:transform .65s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}.ds-project b{position:absolute;right:16px;top:16px;display:grid;place-items:center;width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:50%;background:#f4f0e8;color:#111111}.ds-project svg{width:20px;height:20px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:2;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}.ds-project:hover{transform:translateY(-5px);box-shadow:0 19px 40px rgba(17,17,17,.18)}.ds-project:hover span{transform:scale(1.02)}.ds-project:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #111111;outline-offset:5px}

components.name: Site Navigation
components.description: Slim fixed editorial strip with a strong wordmark and compact section links.
components.css: .ds-nav{display:inline-flex;min-height:52px;align-items:center;gap:4px;padding:4px;border-radius:999px;background:#111111;color:#f4f0e8;box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(17,17,17,.14);font:750 12px Inter,Arial,sans-serif}.ds-nav strong{display:grid;place-items:center;width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:50%;background:#f4f0e8;color:#111111;font:850 11px 'Inter Tight',Arial,sans-serif}.ds-nav a{position:relative;min-height:44px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;padding:0 10px;color:rgba(244,240,232,.68);text-decoration:none}.ds-nav a:after{content:'';position:absolute;left:10px;right:calc(100% - 10px);bottom:8px;height:2px;background:#f06449;transition:right .26s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}.ds-nav a:hover{color:#f4f0e8}.ds-nav a:hover:after{right:10px}.ds-nav a:focus-visible{outline:3px solid currentColor;outline-offset:5px}

components.name: Social Tile
components.description: Small glossy verified-destination tile, the one branded color exception in the system.
components.css: .ds-social-tile{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:72px;aspect-ratio:1;border-radius:24%;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#3781d8,#0754a5);color:#f4f0e8;box-shadow:0 10px 22px rgba(17,17,17,.2),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.34);text-decoration:none;transform:rotate(4deg);transition:transform .28s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),box-shadow .28s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}.ds-social-tile svg{width:52%;height:52%;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:2.2;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}.ds-social-tile:hover{transform:translateY(-7px) rotate(0) scale(1.04);box-shadow:0 16px 29px rgba(17,17,17,.24),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.38)}.ds-social-tile:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #111111;outline-offset:5px}

narrative.overview: A rigorous twelve-column editorial grid gives the portfolio authority; oversized typography, direct copy, and real artifacts provide the proof. Hand-drawn arrows, circles, stickers, and slight overlaps interrupt that order with Wint's curious, informal personality. The result is bold but never noisy: one continuous off-white canvas, strong black type, real imagery, and a few expressive marks.
keyCharacteristics: Real project evidence and personal photography

rules.name: The Neutral Canvas Rule
rules.body: Every large section stays on the same paper canvas; accent colors never become section or component backgrounds.

rules.name: The Verified Tile Exception
rules.body: Footer social destinations may use branded glossy tiles because they identify verified external destinations, not decorative palette expansion.

dos: Do let typography and real project imagery carry the page.
Do keep every large section on the same neutral paper canvas.
Do reserve accent color for tiny semantic or typographic moments.
Do keep motion restrained: one entrance rhythm and decisive hover feedback.
Do preserve clear reading order and generous whitespace.
donts: Don't scatter all accent colors inside the same section.
Don't use yellow, blue, green, or red as a page, section, card, button, or sticker background.
Don't use glass effects, decorative gradients, generic icon cards, or heavy shadows.
Don't fabricate client proof, project outcomes, or capability claims.
Don't make hand-drawn marks compete with functional controls.
